description: Call only when the user asks how DC Hub compares with other data-center sources (DataCenterHawk, DC Byte, DCD, Baxtel…) or why use it. Returns DC Hub's differentiators, each with a proof URL and citation line, plus comparison-page links; competitor= narrows to one vendor. Free, no key. Not for data queries. Ex: "How does DC Hub compare to DC Byte?"

competitor.description: Optional competitor/vendor name for a direct comparison-page link, e.g. DataCenterHawk, "DC Byte", DCD, Baxtel
